experimental_design: For quantification, MaxQuant label-free quantification (LFQ) was utilized, with at least one unique peptide at a minimum ratio count of two.
number_of_fractions: Three fractions of the gradient were taken: Fraction 1: 6 mL (plasma proteins), Fraction 2: 11 mL (platelets), Fraction 3: 4 mL (large platelets).
technology_type: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass Spectrometer

The ionization of separated peptides was performed via electrospray ionization, followed by injection into an Orbitrap Fusion™ Lumos™ Tribrid™ Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA USA).
